title: Balance between degenerate elliptic operators and coercive Hamiltonians
summary: For $p>1$, we consider the boundary value problem for fully nonlinear degenerate elliptic equations $-λ_i(D^2u)+|Du|^p+γu=f(x)$ in bounded domains with Dirichlet or boundary blow-up conditions; here $λ_i(D^2u)$ denotes the $i$-th eigenvalue of the Hessian. We study existence and nonexistence of solutions together with the asymptotic behaviour of the solutions when $γ$ goes to zero. A priori Lipschitz estimates play an important role.
